# AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines — Company Profile
> Production systems engineering company. We take technically difficult products from architecture to production — and stay accountable after launch.

## Organization
Name: AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines
Legal name: AI Infrastructure & Machines
Also known as: AIM, AIM System, AIM Systems, AIM Studio
Registration: Udyam-registered MSME (India)
Location: Madhya Pradesh, India; clients in India, the UK, the US and Europe
Websites: https://aimsystem.in/ · https://aimstudio.co.in/
Client Partner & Technical Lead: Ankit Panicker — works with clients to understand requirements, shape technical direction and coordinate engineering delivery.

## Positioning
Production systems. From architecture to operations. AIM designs, builds and operates software, AI and cloud systems for companies that need one technical owner across the entire system. Software · AI · Cloud · Automation · Reliability. Delivered by one senior engineer, a specialist or a complete team, depending on the system. Senior-led: a small senior team, with specialists added for larger engagements.

## The difference
- We run what we build: APEX Connect, our multi-tenant voice and WhatsApp platform, runs in production for a hospital and a college. Scale, tenant isolation and failure handling are problems we operate.
- No layers between you and engineering: you brief the person designing the system and review the architecture with the person building it. No account managers.
- One technical owner · no vendor handoffs · monitoring, CI/CD and a runbook in every build · named, maintainable stack (Python/FastAPI, Node/TypeScript, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform on AWS, Azure or GCP).

## UK, US & EU teams (https://aimsystem.in/international)
Engineers, specialists, pods or complete teams for UK, US and European companies. One business-to-business contract with AIM.
- UK: IST is 4.5 h ahead in summer, 5.5 h in winter; the whole UK working day overlaps. Work in a UK region (e.g. AWS London, Azure UK South) under UK GDPR data-processing terms.
- Europe: IST is 3.5–4.5 h ahead of central Europe; full working-day overlap. Work in an EU region (e.g. Frankfurt, Ireland) under GDPR data-processing terms.
- US: IST is 9.5–10.5 h ahead of the East Coast; a daily overlap in the US morning (about 08:00–10:30 ET), with work continuing overnight. West Coast teams run async-first with a scheduled overlap. Work in the US region the client chooses.
Work happens in the client's cloud accounts, under the client's security policies and data-processing terms. Client owns all code from the first commit. Delivered in London: Café Ciel at The OWO.

## Services
- Systems Architecture: every engagement starts with the architecture — boundaries, data, failure paths and how it will be operated.
- Product Systems: new products and platforms, from data model to deployment — SaaS, web applications, APIs, backend systems, internal platforms, product modernization.
- Production AI: AI that runs inside real workflows — voice, LLM, RAG, agents — with validation, fallbacks and monitoring.
- Cloud & Reliability: infrastructure, CI/CD, observability and the failure handling that keeps systems up — cloud, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, distributed systems.
- Automation & Integrations: APIs, CRMs, telephony, WhatsApp and data pipelines connected end to end.

## Engagements (https://aimsystem.in/hire)
- Build — a new product or platform: architecture → engineering → production. First deliverable: architecture document and delivery plan.
- Fix — rescue an existing system: architecture review → reliability → performance → modernization. First deliverable: risk map and a stabilisation plan.
- Integrate — connect complex systems: AI, APIs, telephony, WhatsApp, CRMs, workflows, infrastructure. First deliverable: integration design and a working path end to end.
- Operate — take ownership of production: observability, reliability, optimisation, ongoing engineering. First deliverable: monitoring, alerting and a runbook.
Team shape: one senior engineer · specialist · engineering pod · complete team.
Architecture review (https://aimsystem.in/contact?intent=architecture-review): bring your current architecture, bottleneck or production problem; AIM identifies the highest-risk parts and recommends the shortest path forward.
How we work, with the deliverable of each step: Understand (scope brief) → Architect (architecture document and infrastructure plan) → Assemble (named team, roles, delivery plan) → Build (working increments in the client repository, with tests and CI) → Deploy (production release, monitoring dashboards, runbook) → Operate (on-call cover, regular reports, improvement backlog).
Client ownership: client cloud, client API accounts, client-controlled credentials, documented deployment, source ownership, transferable infrastructure.

## Engineering principles
API first · observable · reliable (retries, idempotency, queues, controlled failure handling) · secure · scalable · maintainable.
Security & reliability practices: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, TLS, scoped access, secrets management, audit logging, rate limiting, monitoring, backup, recovery, observability.

## Technology
Python, FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js; PostgreSQL, Redis, Firestore; Azure, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nginx, Cloudflare; Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry; LLMs, RAG, Whisper, Deepgram, XTTS, Kokoro; Twilio, Telnyx, Vapi, SIP, WhatsApp Business API.

## Platforms
- APEX Connect: AI-powered customer engagement infrastructure — multi-tenant architecture, voice infrastructure, messaging, AI orchestration, background workers, queues, retry handling, rate limits, spend controls, observability, provider integrations. Architecture: Tenant → API → Queue → Supervisor → AI → Communication → Analytics. Usage-based pricing.
- AIM Remote AI: AI operating layer connecting phone, desktop and voice to your machine; local or cloud models.
- Healthcare Operations Platform: hospital workflows, patient operations and clinical administration — in development.
- R&D: Shortz media pipeline, Apex Core deterministic automation, Free Tools.

## Selected engineering work
- Healthcare — Apple Hospital, patient outreach on APEX Connect (production; https://aimsystem.in/work#healthcare). Problem: reaching large patient lists for outreach while keeping the operational workload on hospital teams manageable. Constraints: multi-tenant platform shared with other institutions; per-tenant capacity limits; multiple communication providers; voice and WhatsApp in one flow. Architecture: Patient list → Validation → Campaign queue → Voice workers → Retry engine → WhatsApp follow-up → Outcome reporting. AIM owned: architecture, backend workers, telephony and WhatsApp integration, retry scheduling, tenant isolation, deployment and production operation. Stack: APEX Connect, Python, Redis, PostgreSQL, telephony, STT, LLM, TTS, WhatsApp Business API. Result: 15K+ production calls processed, 6.8K+ answered, ~45% connected/answered.
- Education — Multi-Tenant Institutional Communication (BIMTS College; production): dedicated environment for voice outreach and WhatsApp automation with isolated tenant operations. Engineering: isolated tenant architecture, campaign automation, independent tenant configuration, billing separation, outreach tracking.
- Hospitality — Digital Experience Engineering (Café Ciel at The OWO, London; delivered): complete digital experience covering implementation, iterative revisions, deployment and technical delivery on a compressed timeline. Delivery: Design → Implementation → Revisions → Deployment. Delivered on schedule. Testimonial (Vedika, Café Ciel): "Ankit independently delivered a production digital experience for Café Ciel at The OWO, London, within a highly compressed timeline… We would confidently recommend him for future technical engagements."

## Workloads
High-volume communication (campaign orchestration, queues, retries, capacity controls) · multi-tenant platforms (tenant isolation, independent configuration) · AI-powered systems (STT → LLM → TTS pipelines, provider integrations, orchestration) · digital experiences (rapid implementation, iterative development, production deployment) · institutional systems.
Delivery process for an engagement: Understand → Architect → Build → Integrate → Deploy → Operate.
